title: Nam Dinh in a day
summary: A day for pho bo in the morning, the Pho Minh tower, and Phu Day about 15 km southwest. The seal night is the 14th of lunar month 1, not an ordinary evening.

days.title: The tower, then the phu
days.body: Start with pho bo around Cho Rong and Hang Tien. Then the Pho Minh tower on the Tuc Mac ground. If the afternoon is the Mother Goddess complex, Phu Day is about 15 km southwest. Minutes between them are Check on arrival. On the 14th of lunar month 1 the evening is the Tran temple.

stops.name: Pho bo Nam Dinh
stops.note: Eat pho bo around Cho Rong and Hang Tien in the morning.

stops.name: Pho Minh pagoda
stops.note: See the stone tower on the Tuc Mac ground.

stops.name: Phu Day
stops.note: Continue to Phu Day, about 15 km southwest.

additions.name: Tran temple
additions.note: On the 14th of the first lunar month, spend the evening at the Tran temple.

seoTitle: Nam Dinh in a day — Pho Minh and Phu Day
